active_branch.conversion: Continuous fractional photon-energy transfer per path length; initially constant rate
active_branch.working_companion_propagation: Forward at locally measured c, with no secondary energy loss
active_branch.bound_storage: Proposed extended configurations in deeper wells; no-decay/no-escape idealization, not a derived lifetime
active_branch.energy_supply_status: Deferred for current conceptual work, not waived or passed
active_branch.success_criterion: Comparable explanatory and predictive performance to expansion is sufficient; superiority is not required
active_branch.parity_validation: Predeclared tolerances, calibrated uncertainties and independent observations; no equivalence claim solely from nonsignificant differences

galaxy_distances.policy: Adopt published galaxy distances as fixed fictional facts
galaxy_distances.cross_catalog_policy: Record which published value each analysis uses; preserve provenance and do not silently alter the baseline

mandatory: Photon-supplied gravitating deposits or explicitly derived field response
excluded_active_premises: Big Bang initial history or derived standard rulers/chronology
Independent assumed dark-matter component or fitted halo supplied as a source
observations_policy: Retain observations; separate and remove interpretations/reductions that require excluded premises, except explicitly accepted published galaxy distance values
historical_policy: Preserve prior files and results for provenance; excluded theories are not active candidates
deposits_policy: Derive source energy, production, capture, support and gravity; do not rename an assumed dark-matter halo as a deposit
still_unresolved: Microscopic photon/companion conversion and timing law
Source and fuel history without excluded cosmological assumptions
Capture, storage and joint motion/lensing response
Candidate-specific observational likelihood and fresh validation data

conversion_first_direction.original_time_concept: Time/propagation behavior stretches light instead of expansion and thereby causes photon-energy loss; local-galaxy redshift was not excluded.
conversion_first_direction.active_priority: Investigate partial photon-to-companion energy transfer without special time/void stretching as the required cause.
conversion_first_direction.companion_focusing_capture_storage: Derive each separately; focusing does not establish permanent capture.
